summary:
FMLink promotes an episode of the Facility Voices Podcast, produced by ARC Facilities and hosted by David Trask, Senior Director of Customer Education and Success at ARC Facilities. The guest is Skip Vaughn, Assistant Vice President of Facilities Management at American University.

The episode traces Vaughn's career path across construction, military service, federal facilities, and higher education. He began working on construction sites with his father, served as a Coast Guard civil engineer, and held facilities leadership roles at the U.S. General Services Administration, the Architect of the Capitol, and the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), where he was Chief Facilities Management Officer and contributed to national research infrastructure initiatives.

Discussion themes include how military experience translates into facilities management, the value of standardized processes and succession planning, and the growing role of technology in driving operational efficiency. Vaughn also addresses financial pressures facing higher education, American University's sustainability initiatives, and the long-term vision behind designing high-performance, net-zero-ready facilities that support students and institutional resilience.

Vaughn is described as having more than 30 years of experience in the built environment, spanning design, construction, facilities management, the U.S. Coast Guard, the private sector, and three federal agencies, and is positioned as a subject matter expert in facilities management, design, and construction.

The listing notes the episode aired June 30 (article dated August 14, 2026) and that each Facility Voices episode includes supplementary content, with Episode Takeaways hosted on the ARC Facilities site. Readers are invited to connect with host David Trask on LinkedIn.

The piece is promotional show notes rather than analysis. It contains no statistics, no workplace occupancy or booking data, and no discussion of hybrid work policy, visitor management, or desk allocation.

claims.claim: Skip Vaughn has more than 30 years of experience in the built environment across design, construction, facilities management, the Coast Guard, the private sector, and three federal agencies
Vaughn previously served as Chief Facilities Management Officer at NIST, contributing to national research infrastructure initiatives
American University is pursuing sustainability initiatives and designing high-performance, net-zero-ready facilities
